parts.name: The agent as a system
parts.desc: What an agent is mechanically: the harness, the loop, context and memory, retrieval, the protocols between agents, orchestration, and the software chassis that makes all of it testable.

parts.name: The model layer
parts.desc: The part none of your code teaches. Enough depth to reason about latency, capacity, cost and model risk as an architect, and to read the papers behind the serving stack.

parts.name: The rulebook
parts.desc: Governance design: what governance must do when software acts, a reference model, fleet-first tiering, the control as a contract, and the lifecycle with its gates.

parts.name: The referee
parts.desc: Enforcement engineering, chapter by chapter through a working enforcement plane: the governed path, policy, identity, oversight, guardrails, data boundaries, evidence, evals and conformance.

parts.name: The system around the agent
parts.desc: Ordinary system design decides production value. Each chapter ends by pointing at the section of design/pm-agent-at-scale.md it feeds.

parts.name: The agent lifecycle
parts.desc: Building, shipping, running, improving and retiring agents as products: the development lifecycle, frameworks and studios, tools and sandboxes, runtimes and memory, versioning and release, evaluation and optimization, and maintenance.

parts.name: Platforms and tools
parts.desc: The managed services an enterprise actually buys, platform by platform (Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, and the data, SaaS and model-provider platforms), one capability map across them, and the independent tool market.

parts.name: Frameworks and law
parts.desc: External frameworks read through a working build, standards and law turned into an engineered crosswalk, and the overlays regulated industries add.

parts.name: The operating model
parts.desc: People, decision rights and process at the depth an AICoE lead needs, and how to start from low maturity.

parts.name: Practice
parts.desc: Turning knowledge into proof: the two capstones, defending your builds under questioning, and the design interview.

parts.name: Appendices
parts.desc: Reference material: glossary, the control catalog, patterns, decisions, reading map, cards, findings made while writing, and the living register of what comes next.
